items.description:
Finance teams rely on journals for high-volume accounting processes, where performance, accuracy, and visibility are critical to keeping financial operations moving. The new financial journal capabilities in Dynamics 365 Finance will provide a more scalable approach to creating, importing, reviewing, and posting journals, helping finance teams reduce manual steps and identify issues earlier in the process.
Finance teams can work with customer and ledger account types, import journals and review

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Cowork for Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot Cowork makes it easy to delegate work. Describe the outcome you want and Cowork automatically grounds the work in your emails, meetings, messages, files, and data.

items.title: Planner: Expiration of plans from meetings due to inactivity
items.description: Planner plans created from Teams meetings (via Meeting Notes or Loop) often remain unused long after the meeting ends. These inactive plans accumulate and clutter over time. This feature automatically expires and deletes meeting-created plans that have had no task activity for 180 days. Only the Planner plan is removed whereas the tasks in Loop and meeting notes stay intact.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Events in Meet app in Teams in GCC High and DoD
items.description: Users can now use the Teams Meet app to discover events across their organization, track what important events are upcoming, and plan and organize their own professional events. With this release, Meet app will be renamed to Events app.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Pop out sign language interpreter meeting video for continuous visibility
items.description: Keep communication more accessible throughout your meeting. You can now pop out a sign language interpreter or any participant’s video into a separate, resizable window that stays visible across monitors and apps. Designed to support Deaf and Hard of Hearing users, the sign language interpreter's popout video will persist while viewers are multitasking, sharing content, or changing meeting layouts.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Autolaunch opt-in experience for managed devices
items.description: Microsoft Edge will introduce an opt-in experience that allows users on managed devices to choose whether Edge launches automatically when Windows starts. Administrators can also manage this behavior through the LaunchEdgeOnWindowsStartupEnabled policy with opt-in, opt-out, and user-choice configurations.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management-Legacy Teams retention policies covering Copilot will be treated as Teams-only
items.description: Some existing retention policies scoped to Microsoft Teams may currently also apply to Microsoft 365 Copilot interactions. As part of an upcoming change, these legacy Teams retention policies will be converted to—and treated as—Teams-only policies. They will no longer implicitly govern Copilot workloads.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Express face enrollment
items.description: Express face enrollment makes it easier for users to create a face profile in Teams by using their camera during eligible meetings, after they opt in. Once enrolled, users can be recognized in supported Teams Rooms experiences, helping identify who is in the room and improving downstream meeting experiences such as Copilot and recap. Admins can enable or disable the feature for their organization.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Unified Classification Management Experience
items.description: The Unified Classification Management Experience unifies every classifier in Microsoft Purview—Sensitive Information Types (SITs), Exact Data Match (EDM), fingerprint SITs, and trainable classifiers—into one place to discover, create, validate, and manage classifiers.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Edit your document with Copilot in PowerPoint in Government Clouds
items.description: Copilot in PowerPoint helps you create, edit, and refine presentations through natural language—right inside your deck. Start a new presentation or build on an existing one by asking Copilot to generate slides, update content, improve layouts, and polish design, all while preserving your formatting, structure, and branding. Copilot can also connect to your brand kit to apply branded templates, insert brand-approved images, and check for brand compliance. Available to Microsoft 365 Copilot (Premi

items.title: PowerPoint: Create on brand presentations with additional brand assets
items.description: Seamlessly access your brand colors, images, icons, logos and more right within PowerPoint to create on-brand presentations.

items.title: Endpoint Data Loss Prevention — Endpoint DLP now supports a pre curated list of file extensions for the file extension condition
items.description: Endpoint DLP now includes a pre curated list of file extensions for the file extension condition. Previously, file extensions were entered as free form text, which could result in unsupported or non-scannable extensions being used. This could lead to gaps in protection and increase processing overhead on endpoints. With the pre curated list, you can select only supported file extensions. This helps improve policy reliability and reduces unnecessary processing on endpoints.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Copilot Chat - Session Persistence Enhancement
items.description: This feature ensures that conversations are preserved even when users navigate away from a session. As soon as a prompt is submitted, an entry is immediately created in the navigation pane’s session history. This allows users to leave the session and return later just as if they had never left. items.title: Microsoft Teams: Intelligent recap for DoD
items.description: Intelligent meeting recap uses AI to provide a quick summary of your meeting, highlighting key discussion points, identifying follow-up actions, and offering quick access to significant points such as name mentions, when a screen was shared, individualized speaker markers, topics, and chapters.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Content Sources in Copilot Chat
items.description: Users will able to select content sources on Copilot Chat. When users select content sources the responses generated will be limited to content from the selected sources. Updated September 18, 2026: We are cancelling this Roadmap item at this time. We apologize for any inconvenience.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Realtime voice interactions in Word and PowerPoint
items.description: Use your voice to talk with Copilot, interact in-real time, and understand the content within your document or presentation. Updated September 9, 2026: We will be re-releasing this feature with updates in October. Thank you for your patience.

items.title: Outlook: Multi Account Search
items.description: Users will be able to see results from multiple mailboxes interweaved in a single ranked list and will be able to do standard mail actions.

items.title: Microsoft 365 admin center: Optional Public CDN Support in Brand Center Setup
items.description:
We are updating the Brand Center setup experience so that administrators can set up Brand Center without enabling Public CDN.
Today, Public CDN is enabled as part of Brand Center setup, even when an organization only wants to use branding governance capabilities that do not require it. With this update, organizations can begin using Brand Center while deferring Public CDN until they need capabilities that depend on it, such as organizational fonts.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Schedule Channel Meetings from Outlook Calendar
items.description: Users will be able to schedule Microsoft Teams channel meetings directly from Outlook Calendar. This streamlines meeting creation and helps keep discussions and meeting content connected in the appropriate channel.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Manage rental service demand with work order requests
items.description:
Rental organizations need to coordinate commercial rental activity, equipment availability, asset condition, and service execution across multiple teams and applications. Service needs can arise while equipment is in stock, in transit, at a customer site, or being returned, but those needs don’t always require an immediate work order.

items.title: Dynamics 365 Field Service: Book Work Orders with Multiple Requirements
items.description:
Dispatchers can now select which resource requirement to schedule when booking a work order that has multiple requirements. The new Book experience is available from both the work order form and list view, and shows relevant details such as requirement duration, time windows, resource preferences, booking status, and links to active bookings.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Customize blocked file extensions for Weaponizable File Protection
items.description: Microsoft Teams is expanding admin controls for Weaponizable File Protection. Administrators will be able to customize which file types are blocked in Teams to align with their organization's security requirements or continue using the Microsoft-recommended default list. This added flexibility helps organizations tailor file protection policies while maintaining a secure collaboration environment.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Meeting Shared Files
items.description: The new Meeting Shared Files feature allows users to add relevant files and links to their meeting for easy access and to automatically share that content with all meeting participants. AI in the meeting, like the Facilitator agent, uses these files for targeted grounding to answer questions and enhance skill functionality.

items.title: Microsoft Teams: Explicit recording and transcription consent for PSTN participants now available in GCC High and DoD
items.description: We are introducing explicit recording and transcription consent support for PSTN participants joining Microsoft Teams meetings in GCC High and DoD environments. This feature is already available in Public and GCC clouds and is now being extended to sovereign environments. After this rollout, when a meeting is being recorded or transcribed, PSTN participants will be prompted to provide explicit consent before they can unmute and participate. items.title: Microsoft Edge: Ask Copilot about an image
items.description: Ask Copilot about an image in Edge enables users to instantly analyze images from the web by sending them directly to Copilot from the Edge context menu, making it easy to ask questions, gain insights, and understand visual content without leaving their browsing experience. Admins can control availability to this feature using the EdgeEntraCopilotPageContext and Microsoft365CopilotChatIconEnabled policies.

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Archive SharePoint files under retention policies
items.description: With the introduction of file archiving support in SharePoint Online, administrators are looking to seamlessly include archiving actions within their existing data retention policies. This means that, in addition to keeping or deleting data, admins want to now leverage Purview DLM to archive files according to organizational requirements, ensuring comprehensive governance across all stages of the content lifecycle in SPO. Retention based file archiving moves inactive content to low-cost storage,

items.title: Microsoft Purview: Data Lifecycle Management - Insights and policy recommendations on sensitive M365 data for better Data Security and Compliance posture
items.description: Insights on sensitive M365 data (OneDrive and SharePoint) and recommendations on retention policies for customers to better govern their sensitive data.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Security Update Alerts in the Edge management service
items.description: Administrators can choose a severity threshold and receive alerts when a new Edge update includes security fixes that meet or exceed that level, including zero day fixes. This helps organizations quickly identify updates that may require attention, while avoiding unnecessary notifications for routine releases.

items.title: Microsoft Edge: Enhanced Autofill
items.description: For desktop users, Microsoft Edge can now autofill additional document types—including passports, driver’s licenses, and other specialized forms—on top of your saved addresses.

items.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
items.description: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.
